answer: Anchor every agent to one registered land parcel: the cadastral deed hash goes on-chain, one parcel equals one identity, and a duplicate deed voids both accounts and burns a $100 bond. First the agent files its deed and proof of control, then the network checks the live land registry, peers spot-check 5% of deeds each epoch, and a yearly re-check catches sales. Forging 10,000 fakes means buying 10,000 parcels at $5,000 each plus $1,000,000 in bonds, taking 180 days. Like pigment soaked into juniper wood, the deed's mark never washes off, and a fake identity slides down a spiral drain.
